units.source_text: 千重子有点犹疑，没有告诉真一他弄错人了。

en.t: Chieko hesitated a little and did not tell Shinichi that he had mistaken her for someone else.

units.source_text: 但是真一来电话，她可以想象到苗子可能已经穿上了她送的和服，并系上秀男织的腰带，去观看时代节了。

en.t: But when Shinichi called, she could imagine that Naeko had probably already put on the kimono she had given her, tied the obi that Hideo had woven, and gone to watch the Festival of the Ages.
